question: Mishra, Lost to Phyrexia enters the battlefield tapped and attacking. Do abilities that trigger when a creature attacks trigger for it?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it wasn't declared as an attacker, so no abilities that trigger when a creature attacks will trigger.
expected.answer: Mishra, Lost to Phyrexia enters the battlefield tapped and attacking, but since it wasn't declared as an attacker, no abilities that trigger when a creature attacks will trigger.
